title: IVG Pro 12 Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Raspberry Cherry IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods deliver a rich combination of red and dark berries, bringing together sweet Strawberry, tangy Raspberry and bold Cherry. The result is a layered fruit profile that’s juicy and full-flavoured. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 0mg, 10mg or 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 10ml refill reservoir that connects easily. Once assembled, the system auto-tops the pod as you vape, providing up to 10,000 puffs per kit with no refilling or coil changes required. Built for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, these pods use mesh coil technology to deliver smooth, reliable MTL vapour and great flavour. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
